subject: SummerSeed cohort: packaging options and request for extra credits / escalation
messages:
From: Ella Park <ella@summerseed.vc>
To: Logan Wright <logan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: SummerSeed Accelerator Ops <ops@summerseed.vc>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Inquiry: cohort pilot pricing and free credits for SummerSeed

Hi Logan,

Quick intro — I run operations for SummerSeed (we run a seasonal accelerator, next cohort starts May 15). We're evaluating pilot infrastructure partners and liked Redwood's latency/cost playbook.

We have 10 early-stage startups who will all run small LLM workloads (chat assistants, embeddings for search, and simple reranking). Typical expected usage: ~50k tokens/month per company in months 1-3, with spikes during demo week.

Ask: can Redwood provide a cohort packaging option that includes promotional/free credits for the cohort + a short promotional discount for our sponsors? Specifically: a one-time bundle of free tokens that covers the first month for each company (roughly 500k tokens total), plus a promotional discount on hosted API pricing (we'd love something in the 25–35% range for months 1–3). Our sponsors need a written offer by May 1 to approve the budget.

I've attached a short cohort outline (SummerSeed_Cohort_Outline.pdf) and can share usage projections if helpful.

Can you send a few concrete packaging/pricing options (starter cohort pack vs pilot/dedicated onramp) and let me know who to loop in for contract/finance? Time is tight.

Thanks — appreciate it.

Ella Park
Operations Lead, SummerSeed Accelerator
ella@summerseed.vc

Attachment: SummerSeed_Cohort_Outline.pdf (application summary, expected timeline)

From: Logan Wright <logan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ella Park <ella@summerseed.vc>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com, priyom_das@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Inquiry: cohort pilot pricing and free credits for SummerSeed

Hi Ella — great to meet you over email and congrats on the upcoming cohort. Short answer: yes, we have two common paths for cohorts and a limited promotional top-up loop we can apply. Details below.

Option A — Starter Cohort Pack (hosted)- One bundled credit allocation: 500k free tokens split across cohort (configurable)- 25% off list hosted API rates for months 1–3- No minimum commit, self-serve onboarding, includes basic cost/latency dashboard- Good when each team is low-usage and you want fast time-to-value

Option B — Onramp Pilot (reserved for higher initial throughput)- Dedicated burst pool with 50% discount on token compute for committed usage tiers for months 1–3- Provisioned reserved slots for demo week to avoid throttling- Requires a simple MSA addendum (1–2 week turnaround)

Operational notes and caveats- The free-token bundle is a one-time promotional allocation that appears on billing as an initial credit (cannot be rolled forward beyond 90 days).- Discounts above 25% for hosted plans require commercial approval and may come with a short commit.- We typically issue credits under program code 'COHORT-ONRAMP-2027' and need a signed confirmation and an expected usage table from you so finance can record the promo.

I've attached a quick pricing worksheet with numbers for both paths (cohort-pricing-sheet.xlsx). Can you confirm: (1) whether you'll accept credits split per team or a pooled credit, (2) expected month 1 usage per team, and (3) whether sponsors require Redwood to provide logo/exposure? If you need a faster decision, I can pull in our partnerships lead (Ben Carter) to discuss sponsor concessions, and our program ops (Priyom Das) on credit issuance timing.

Next steps: if you want us to escalate for a higher promotional top-up we need a short note from you describing the sponsor value exchange (co-branding, intros, joint PR) and your target numbers. If you send that today we can aim to have a written offer by Apr 27.

Best,

Logan Wright
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
logan@redwoodinference.com
Attachment: cohort-pricing-sheet.xlsx (pricing scenarios and token math)

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan@redwoodinference.com>, laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 23 Apr 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Inquiry: cohort pilot pricing and free credits for SummerSeed

Adding ops context.

Logan — thanks for the clear options. A few operational constraints you'll want to include in any offer to SummerSeed:

1) Credit issuance window: we can post the one-time promotional credit to the customer's billing account within 48 hours of signed confirmation, but credits expire 90 days after issuance.

2) Accounting/legal: any discount >25% for hosted without an upfront commit requires Finance signoff and an approval note from Partnerships. For cohorts where sponsor visibility is provided (logo placement / sponsor intros), we can generally approve a discretionary top-up of up to +10% in free credits (one-time) without a revenue commit — subject to Ben's greenlight.

3) Scaling protections: for demo week spikes we can provision burst capacity but require a simple addendum to cover guaranteed burst units; otherwise we rely on our auto-fallback policies (we'll provide a capacity plan).

If SummerSeed needs a larger concession (e.g., +20–30% free tokens or a 30% hosted discount), that needs a commercial exception routed to Ben with the sponsor value summary and the cohort impact (expected ARR conversion or logos).

Logan: happy to draft the approval language for finance if you share the sponsor exchange details.

-Priyom
Program Operations, Redwood Inference

From: Ella Park <ella@summerseed.vc>
To: Logan Wright <logan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: SummerSeed Accelerator Ops <ops@summerseed.vc>, ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2027 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Inquiry: cohort pilot pricing and free credits for SummerSeed

Logan / team — thanks for the clear options and quick turnaround. SummerSeed is leaning toward Option A (Starter Cohort Pack) but we have two asks before we can sign off and present to sponsors:

1) Extra credits: would Redwood consider an additional one-time promo top-up of 20% on top of the 500k bundle? Our sponsors want to see a bigger initial runway to encourage teams to experiment.

2) Discount: can you move the hosted discount to 30% for the first 3 months? We can offer sponsor value (logo visibility on our homepage, two sponsor mentions in cohort communications, and an intro to one anchor partner) as part of the exchange.

If you can't do both, we'd take the 20% credit boost and accept 25% discount. We need the written offer by May 1 to include in sponsor materials.

Drive folder with cohort decks and sponsor package: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cSummerSeedDocs

Please escalate as needed — if Ben or Finance requires a formal sponsor-exchange note I can prepare that today. We can sign a short addendum electronically; DocuSign is fine.

Appreciate the help,

Ella Park
Operations Lead, SummerSeed Accelerator
ella@summerseed.vc
